<thought>The template search with “aldehydes” returned no results, so I’ll broaden the query to look for any carbonyl‑coupling template that breaks “ketones” (which also covers aldehydes) and forms a C‑C double bond. This should retrieve a McMurry‑type retrosynthetic template that can convert two p‑anisaldehyde molecules into the target stilbene.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
